lead: The artifact panel: the area beside the conversation that shows what the model produced (a document, code, a web page). Its header holds a title, a view switch (preview / code), actions and a close button; in the conversation, an `ArtifactCard` points to it.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: The body takes anything: here the preview is `Markdown` and the code view a `CodeBlock`.

card.title: Card and panel
card.description: An `ArtifactCard` in the conversation: `aria-pressed` tells whether its artifact is open beside it.

api.title: API Reference
api.description: `Artifact` is a compound component; the parts without props of their own take the props of the element they render.
api.root: Root of the panel: a `section` (region) named by its Title. Put it in a parent with a height: it fills it and scrolls its content inside
api.header: Header: title, note, view switch, actions
api.titlePart: Title, also the name of the whole panel
api.meta: A short note next to the title ("Document · v2")
api.views: View switch (preview / code), the library's `Segmented`; `aria-label` defaults to "View"
api.actions: A row of actions (`role=group`, `aria-label` defaults to "Actions")
api.action: An icon button (`aria-label` required) / the close button (named "Close" by default)
api.body: Content area: keyboard focusable, scrolls inside when the content overflows; `aria-label` defaults to "Content"
api.card: A small card in the conversation pointing to an artifact: a button whose `aria-pressed` tells whether the artifact is open; clicking it opens the `Artifact` beside it.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: Root of the panel (a bordered vertical flex)
styling.header: The header and its title, note and action group
styling.card: The artifact card in the conversation; `data-selected` when its artifact is open
